sn35.161:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Jīvakambavane || || Tatra kho Bhagavā bhikkhū amantesi || la || || Paṭisallāṇe bhikkhave yogam āpajjatha || paṭisallīṇassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno yathābhūtam okkhāyati || || Kiñca yathābhūtam okkhāyati || || Cakkhu aniccanti yathābhūtam okkhāyati || Rūpā aniccāti yathābhūtam okkhāyati || Cakkhuviññāṇam aniccanti yathābhūtam okkhāyati || Cakkhusamphasso aniccoti yathābhūtam okkhāyati || Yam pidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā vedayitam || pe || tam pi Aniccanti yathābhūtam okkhāyati || || Sotam || || Ghānam || || Jivhā || || Kāyo || || Mano anicco ti yathābhūtam okkhāyati || Dhammā || Manoviññāṇaṃ || Manosamphasso || Yam pidam manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitam sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā || tam pi Aniccanti yathabhūtam okkhāyati || || Patisallāṇe bhikkhave yogam āpajjatha || patisallīṇassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno yathabhūtam okkhāyatīti || || Atha
